title: Triple Forces Strike
next_chapter_hook: Just as the three forces faced off with swords drawn and tension mounting, a strange purple glow suddenly spread across the distant horizon—a fourth force that had never appeared in any intelligence report was approaching the ruins.

text.content: Before dawn's light could fully dispel the night, the air at the ruins' entrance had already become suffocating with tension. Chen Ji stood behind a broken stone tablet, his pupils contracted into dangerous needle points. Just moments ago, he had been contemplating the deeper meaning behind Su Qingyao's words, when three distinctly different auras suddenly surged into his perception—one厚重如山 like a mountain, tinged with the Xuanwu Sect's mysterious water element; one cold and sinister, carrying the corrosive aura unique to the Demonic Path; and the last one grand and dignified, the unmistakable signature of the joint forces of the three great sects. The three factions had arrived at this desolate land at precisely the same hour.

Chen Ji murmured to himself, his tone betraying not the slightest trace of panic. He slowly closed his eyes, and the imperfect Tianji Record mark at his brow center faintly warmed—not to动用那珍贵的fate, but to use his most primitive spiritual sense to scan everything around him. To the southeast, the Xuanwu Sect's formation banners had already been planted on three mountain peaks, their mysterious water energy forming an invisible water curtain that shrouded the entire ruins. In the forest to the northwest, the distinctive black mist of the Demonic Path could be seen writhing within the bushes. As for due north... Chen Ji's gaze slightly frosted—there stood a figure he knew all too well. Ling Yuan, that old fox whose surface benevolence concealed a ruthless heart, stood with hands clasped behind his back, as if everything was under his control.

dialogue.content: Where is that boy Chen Ji? Why hasn't he come out to greet this old man?

text.content: Ling Yuan's voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly carried across the entire ruins entrance. Chen Ji coldly smirked in his heart—this old fox knew full well the extreme dangers within the ruins, yet deliberately used this method to force him out. Either he wanted him to die inside the ruins, or he intended to expose his waste of a disciple facade before everyone. Either way, it meant his meticulously maintained identity as a chess piece was about to be exposed.

dialogue.content: Senior Ling, please be patient. This disciple will come out immediately.

text.content: Chen Ji stepped out slowly from behind the stone tablet, his face wearing the habitual expression of timidity and deference. He deliberately made his gait somewhat unsteady, shoulders slightly hunched, looking like a quail frightened out of its wits. However, the instant he raised his head, his gaze met Ling Yuan's in the air—at that fleeting moment, a sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes before he immediately returned to his dazed appearance. He had seen the flash of greed in Ling Yuan's eyes, and also the contempt on the Xuanwu Sect disciples' faces. Chen Ji silently recited: Old thing, do you think you're the only one playing chess?

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing hides in the shadows, observing Chen Ji's performance, nodding secretly in her heart: This man, truly has not disappointed me.)

text.content: Just then, the black mist to the northwest suddenly churned violently, and a sinister laugh echoed from within the fog: 'Old Ling, your Tianqing Sect'strashdisciple is quite well hidden, daring to be the first to rush into these desolate ruins.' Before the words finished, a black figure shot out from the fog and landed three zhang before Chen Ji. The newcomer's face was handsome yet tinged with evil, his narrow long eyes emitting a ghostly green glow—this was indeed a master from the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, with cultivation at least at the late Golden Core stage.

choice.prompt: Faced with the Demonic Path master's provocation and the encirclement of three forces, Chen Ji must make a choice.

choices.description: Seize the moment before the three forces form a complete encirclement, charging into the depths of the ruins at the fastest speed, using the mechanisms and formations within to buy time for himself. The risk is extremely high, but success would completely free him from the current predicament.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 50 Heavenly Fate points to activate Tianji Record early warning
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a three-day safe window period
choices.risk_hint: The interior of the ruins is dangerously unknown, and will expose part of his strength

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze flashed, a barely perceptible arc curving at the corner of his mouth. He suddenly clutched his chest, face turning deathly pale as he stumbled back two steps, his voice trembling as he cried out: 'P-Please spare me, Senior! I'm just atrashservant, I don't know anything!' While shouting, he stumbled toward the ruins entrance, looking like prey whose courage had been completely shattered, fleeing for its life.

choices.description: Exploit the suspicion between the three forces, release false intelligence to make Ling Yuan and the Demonic Path tear each other apart, while sitting back to reap the benefits. Requires exquisite rhetoric and precise timing.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 30 strategic points for rhetoric arrangement
choices.visible_reward: The three forces will check each other, buying activity space for himself
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, he will offend two forces simultaneously

text.content: Chen Ji unhurriedly took a broken Jade Slip from his怀中, raised both hands high, his voice carrying appropriately calibrated terror: 'Please spare me, Seniors! This disciple, this disciple has something here...' He deliberately exposed the patterns on the Jade Slip—it was clearly a fragment of an ancient formation. Ling Yuan's eyes abruptly contracted—that was one of the keys to opening the core area of the ruins.

choices.description: Continue playing the waste persona, asking the three major forces for protection as an innocent, so as to infiltrate and understand their hidden cards. The risk is lowest, but it requires supreme acting skills.
choices.visible_cost: Endure humiliation and difficulties, reputation temporarily declines
choices.visible_reward: Observe the three parties' hidden cards up close, obtain key intelligence
choices.risk_hint: May be sacrificed as a discarded piece, or eliminated by Ling Yuan using this opportunity

text.content: Chen Ji threw himself to the ground with a thud, prostrating completely, trembling like a sieve: "Disciple, disciple is just a servant disciple! I don't know anything! I beg the seniors for mercy, disciple is willing to do anything for the seniors!" His voice was mournful and desperate, anyone looking would see a terrified waste of a person. However, just as he lowered his head, that cold gleam in his eyes flickered briefly—he was waiting, waiting for these people to reveal their flaws.

dialogue.content: Snorting, how dare the trash of the Demonic Path come to join the fun? Ling Yuan coldly snorted, his figure flickering to stand in front of Chen Ji, "This junior disciple is a person of my Tianqing Sect, you Demonic Path have no right to touch him!"

text.content: Chen Ji knelt on the ground, but his mind was rapidly calculating. Ling Yuan's words seemed to protect him, but in reality they were declaring ownership of this formation disk to the Demonic Path—after all, how could a waste servant possibly possess the key to opening the core of the ruins? There must be something fishy here. He glanced with his peripheral vision towards the due north, where the representatives sent by the three major sects stood, each with gloomy faces, clearly extremely dissatisfied with Ling Yuan's arbitrary actions. Three forces, each with their own scheming thoughts.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing transmitted voice in secret: You actually believe that old fox Ling Yuan? He just wants to use you as a pathfinder. There's a hidden passage on the west side of the ruins, I can take you in, but you must promise me one thing—that Nine Nether Mysterious Lotus inside, I want it.)

text.content: Nine Nether Mysterious Lotus? Chen Ji's heart tightened. That was a legendary peerless spiritual medicine that could cure all poisons and extend lifespan, with even more miraculous effects of washing tendons and reshaping marrow for those of the Demonic Path. Ye Qing actually knew such a thing was in the ruins, showing her understanding of this place was far deeper than he had imagined. He didn't immediately respond, but continued maintaining that trembling appearance, while his peripheral vision observed the expression changes of everyone present. Ling Yuan seemed to be speaking up for him on the surface, but undisguised killing intent was hidden deep in his eyes; although the Demonic Path experts were arrogant, they also feared Ling Yuan's cultivation; and the people from the three major sects...

Chen Ji suddenly noticed that one among the three major sects' representatives was staring fixedly at the Jade Slip in his hand, his eyes flickering with greed and calculation. An idea formed in his mind—since all three parties wanted this key, he would let them fight over it themselves.

choice.prompt: The three forces were at a stalemate, Chen Ji had to break this balance.

choices.description: Deliberately expose the Jade Slip to the Demonic Path expert, create conflict between Ling Yuan and the Demonic Path, escape in the chaos.
choices.visible_reward: The three parties fall into chaos, gaining breathing room
choices.risk_hint: Will completely offend Ling Yuan, may have trouble later

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly broke free from Ling Yuan's protection, scrambling towards the Demonic Path expert while shouting: "Senior save me! Jade Slip, this Jade Slip is for you, I beg you to take me away!" His acting was flawless, that fear and despair made it impossible for anyone to see through the act. Ling Yuan's face instantly darkened, the killing intent in his eyes could no longer be hidden—this little waste dared to defect to the Demonic Path right in front of him?

choices.description: Create the illusion of being killed, slip away while the three parties' attention is scattered, let Ye Qing's people provide support.
choices.visible_cost: Reputation temporarily returns to zero, needs to rebuild from scratch
choices.visible_reward: Completely escape the three parties' sight, can act freely
choices.risk_hint: Identity completely cleared, all interpersonal relationships reset to zero

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly stopped in his tracks, his whole body frozen in place. He slowly lowered his head, looking at a sudden blood hole in his chest, an expression of disbelief on his face—that was the Demonic Path expert's unique secret weapon "Shadowless Needle". However, from an angle no one could see, Chen Ji's finger was already pressing on a Life-Substituting Talisman. His body softly fell, breath completely gone—more dead than dead.

choices.description: Directly activate the Tianji Record's warning ability, show the crowd part of the truth inside the ruins, exchange this for negotiation leverage.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the qualification for equal dialogue with the three parties
choices.risk_hint: The aura of the Tianji Record may attract even more powerful existences

text.content: Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, brushing the dust off his clothes. The terrified expression on his face gradually faded, replaced by a cold tranquility. He raised his head, meeting Ling Yuan's gaze directly: 'Senior Ling, the thing you desire is not merely this single Jade Slip, is it?' Before the words finished, the mark at his brow center suddenly illuminated, and an arcane pattern unfurled slowly in the air. That was the aura of the Tianji Record—ancient, mysterious, and ineffable. Everyone was stunned, including Ling Yuan.

dialogue.content: 'You... how dare you...!' Ling Yuan's voice trembled, not from fear, but from wild joy. 'The aura of the Tianji Record! So the Fragment was on you all along! This old man has waited an entire three hundred years!'

text.content: Three hundred years of obsession exploded in this moment. Ling Yuan could no longer maintain his benevolent mask, his eyes crimson as he lunged toward Chen Ji. The disciples of Xuanwu Sect had never seen their old sect master so agitated, momentarily frozen in confusion. Yet the demonic path expert reacted swiftly—seeing such a massive opening in Ling Yuan, how could he miss this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity? The ghostly green flying sword silently stabbed toward Ling Yuan's back. The cultivators from the three great sects, after brief shock, rapidly formed a formation—their target had only ever been one thing: the Tianji Record Fragment.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji coldly smiled in his heart: Old fool, did you think you were the only one waiting? Three hundred years ago the Tianji Record abandoned you, and three hundred years later you still cannot see through it. Very well, since you want it so badly, let me show you where this Fragment will ultimately lead you.)

text.content: Chen Ji swept his sleeve, and a profound light enveloped both himself and Ling Yuan. Within that radiance, countless ancient runes flowed vaguely, emanating a terrifying pressure that made hearts palpitate. Ling Yuan's flying sword was repelled when striking the profound light, and the demonic expert's ambush also struck empty air—the entire space seemed frozen by some kind of force. The cultivators from the three great sects changed color drastically; they finally realized that this waste of a disciple was no servant at all, but a supreme expert who held the ancient supreme treasure.

At this moment, a strange purple light suddenly spread across the distant horizon. That radiance was like a giant eye slowly opening, steadily scanning every person on the battlefield. Chen Ji looked up, his pupils contracting sharply—that was the aura of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, a hundred times more intense than any he had sensed before. He suddenly understood something, and for the first time his expression changed: the aura of the Tianji Record had awakened the existence it had been waiting for.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Dao's Eye's gaze threw the situation into complete chaos; Chen Ji had to make an immediate decision.

choices.description: Immediately evacuate through the hidden passage, leaving Ling Yuan and the three great sects to the Heavenly Dao's Eye's gaze. Cooperation with Ye Qing officially begins.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Demon Sect Saint's trust, unlocking a new ally relationship
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's true intentions remain unclear

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing's voice sounded at the right moment: Come with me, don't look back. That eye is not something you can oppose, at least not now.)

choices.text: Resist the Heavenly Dao's Eye directly
choices.description: Concentrate all power to oppose that gaze, attempting to suppress it before it fully awakens. This is a gamble that may completely expose all hidden cards.
choices.visible_cost: Consume all remaining Heavenly Fate points, possibly suffering severe injury
choices.visible_reward: The Heavenly Dao's Eye temporarily retreats, buying precious time
choices.risk_hint: If failed, one will be directly erased by the Heavenly Will

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his hands forming an ancient and complex seal. The mark at his brow center suddenly burst forth with blinding light, echoing across the void toward the purple light in the sky. He sensed a vast and supreme power seeping through from the Void—an existence that transcended his comprehension: the Heavenly Dao's Eye. It was neither a person nor a faction, but the materialization of the world's operating rules. The disparity between the two was like a firefly against the bright moon.

choices.description: Activate the bloodline connection with his sister, utilizing her special constitution as the 'Heavenly Fate Key' to disrupt the Heavenly Dao's Eye's lock. This is Chen Ji's last trump card.
choices.visible_cost: May expose Chen Nian's existence, drawing greater danger
choices.visible_reward: Completely break free from Heaven's Eye's lock, laying the groundwork for rescuing his sister
choices.risk_hint: Heaven's Eye will track Chen Nian's location

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking into the残缺的印记 deep within his Brow Center. In the deepest corner of his heart, he called out a name—Chen Nian, his sister who had been missing for years, his only kin in this world. The Tianji Record had once told him that after Chen Nian was taken by the Holy Sect, she was transformed into a "Heavenly Fate Lock Key." Her existence could disrupt all fate-related divinations. If she could sense his call, if she still retained a flicker of consciousness...

The purple eye in the sky seemed to sense something, its pupil contracting sharply. A pressure ten times stronger than before descended, enveloping the entire ruin entrance. Ling Yuan's expression finally changed—he stopped pursuing Chen Ji and hastily formed a defensive formation. The Demonic Path experts and the three major sects' forces all felt that destructive force and retreated. Yet at that moment, a ethereal voice suddenly sounded in Chen Ji's mind—it was Chen Nian's voice, weak and distant: Brother... I heard you...

It was this instant. The connection between the purple eye in the sky and Chen Ji suddenly suffered a momentary disruption. That enormous pupil trembled violently, as if trying to lock onto a target but repeatedly missing. Chen Ji seized this fleeting opportunity, his figure flickering as he fled into the ruins' depths. Ye Qing's secret passage entrance was right there—that Demonic Path Saintess had indeed not deceived him. As he passed through that concealed fissure, Ling Yuan's angry roar and the deafening chaos of three factions locked in combat echoed behind him.

Chen Ji landed in a safe area deep within the secret passage, his back pressed against the cold stone wall, gasping for breath. That previous scene had been too perilous—the Heaven's Eye's gaze was far more terrifying than he had anticipated, that sensation of being locked onto by the world's laws still making his heart palpitate. But at the same time, he felt an inexplicable warmth. Chen Nian... she still had consciousness, she could still hear his call. This understanding comforted him more than anything else. No matter the cost, he would find her.

Soft footsteps echoed from deep within the secret passage. Chen Ji abruptly looked up to see Ye Qing emerging from the shadows, that bewitching face carrying a meaningful smile: "Young Master Chen, your performance exceeded my expectations. However, I'm curious—who was that person you called out to just now? An existence that could cause Heaven's Eye to fall into chaos must be extraordinary, no?" Her tone was casual, yet her eyes gleamed with cunning light.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged; only he knew the surging killing intent in his heart: Ye Qing, you'd better pray you're useful to me, otherwise...)

text.content: Just as the atmosphere was about to freeze, a low rumbling sound suddenly came from deep within the secret passage. Both Ye Qing and Chen Ji changed color—that was the sign of a formation mechanism being triggered. Someone had entered this secret passage before them. Chen Ji's gaze hardened as he spoke quietly: "It seems our ally isn't just you." Before his words finished, a familiar figure slowly walked out from the depths—a familiar silhouette that completely disrupted Chen Ji's expectations, transforming this already complex situation into something even more enigmatic. It was Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of the Tianqing Sect who should have been outside. Her appearance shattered Chen Ji's expectations and made this inherently complicated situation even more unpredictable.
